import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int mod, n, m, i, j, k;
    static int[][] c = new int[505][505];
    static long[] f = new long[505];
    static long[] g = new long[505];
    static long[][][] dp = new long[505][505][2];
    static long ans = 0;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();

        c[0][0] = 1;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            c[i][0] = 1;
            for (j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                c[i][j] = (c[i - 1][j] + c[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
            }
        }

        f[0] = 1;
        for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                int kVal = i - j - 1;
                f[i] = (f[i] + (f[j] * f[kVal] % mod) * (i + 1) % mod * c[i - 1][j]) % mod;
                g[i] = (g[i] + (g[j] * f[kVal] % mod) * (i + 1) % mod * c[i - 1][j]) % mod;
                g[i] = (g[i] + (f[j] * g[kVal] % mod) * (i + 1) % mod * c[i - 1][j]) % mod;
                long term = ((long) j * (j + 1) / 2 + (long) kVal * (kVal + 1) / 2);
                g[i] = (g[i] + (f[j] * f[kVal] % mod) * c[i - 1][j] % mod * term % mod) % mod;
            }
        }

        dp[0][0][1] = 1;
        for (i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
                dp[i + 1][j][1] = (dp[i + 1][j][1] + dp[i][j][0] + dp[i][j][1]) % mod;
                for (k = 0; k < n - i; k++) {
                    long val = (dp[i][j][1] * f[k] % mod) * c[j + k][j] % mod;
                    dp[i + k + 1][j + k + 1][0] = (dp[i + k + 1][j + k + 1][0] + val) % mod;
                }
            }
        }

        for (j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            for (i = 0; i <= j; i++) {
                int rem = m - (j - i + 1);
                if (rem < 0) continue;
                for (k = 0; k <= rem; k++) {
                    long temp = g[j - i + 1] * dp[i][k][1] % mod * dp[n - j][rem - k][1] % mod;
                    temp = temp * c[m][rem] % mod * c[rem][k] % mod;
                    ans = (ans + temp) % mod;
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(ans);
        sc.close();
    }
}
